\section{Purpose and conformance target}

This specification tells a reviewer how to decide whether one exact candidate
conforms to SCI-MAP v0.2. It does not select a candidate, inspect an
implementation, execute validation, or assert a result. Before work begins,
the reviewer freezes:

\begin{itemize}
\item repository and immutable candidate identity;
\item build profile, compiler/runtime identities, configuration, and enabled
parallel modes;
\item exact input fixtures and independent expected-value generators;
\item numerical comparison policy and simultaneous statistical error policy;
\item required product list, representation paths, log policy, and completion
criteria; and
\item the shared-authority digest, contract version, this document revision,
owner-decision ledger revision, exact byte-identical PTC-to-MAP boundary
digest, exact original-footprint-coordinate boundary, source-bound MAP
profile versions, six product-role identities, coadd Registry record, owner
r0.2 directive identity/digest, and the exact candidate paired
\SCIMapCandidateVALRegistry{} and \SCIMapCandidateVALSourceRegister{} records.
Candidate records are not treated as owner-accepted, canonically activated, or
frozen merely because their bytes and hashes are complete.
\end{itemize}

Evidence from a different candidate, configuration, or science-authority
digest is not silently pooled. Each rerun keeps its own identity and reason.
Historical operational acceptance does not substitute for conformance
evidence.

\section{Evidence record}

Each requirement record contains at least:

\begin{longtable}{L{0.24\linewidth}L{0.66\linewidth}}
\toprule
Field & Required content\\
\midrule
Requirement & Stable \texttt{SCI-MAP-REQ-NNN} and shared-authority digest.\\
Candidate & Exact source/build identity and environment profile.\\
Observable & Public product, typed state, API boundary, metadata, diagnostic,
or failure transition under test.\\
Fixture & Immutable input identity and independent expected-value calculation.\\
Comparison & Exact predicate or preregistered numerical/statistical bound.\\
Result & Exactly one of \texttt{pass}, \texttt{fail}, \texttt{blocked},
\texttt{not\_applicable}, or \texttt{not\_assessed}. Skipped required evidence
is \texttt{not\_assessed}, never a pass.\\
Artifact realization & Exactly one of \texttt{complete},
\texttt{incomplete}, \texttt{failed}, or \texttt{not\_produced}; this records
the evidence artifact and never substitutes for the requirement result.\\
Artifacts & Machine-readable outputs, logs, traces, plots/tables where needed,
and digest-addressed provenance.\\
Reviewer & Independent reviewer identity, date, and deviation disposition.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\SCIMapRequirementResultDefinition

Failures are retained as evidence. A tolerance, fixture, expected result, or
applicability decision is not changed after viewing a failure without opening
a new preregistered record.

\section{Claim-layer gates}

Passing one layer grants no stronger layer automatically.

\begin{longtable}{L{0.22\linewidth}L{0.31\linewidth}L{0.37\linewidth}}
\toprule
Layer & Minimum engineering record & Prohibited inference\\
\midrule
Algebraic contract & Exact owner-dispositioned shared authority and internally consistent
independent expected values. & No claim that a candidate implements it.\\
Engineering conformance & Every applicable requirement passes on one exact
candidate; no required skip, unresolved deviation, or false completion. & No
claim that persisted WCS/response is scientifically faithful in real data.\\
Representation/response fidelity & Round-trip and injection evidence covers
WCS, units, response classes, boundaries, and covariance representations with
preregistered bounds. & No observational photometric, astrometric, or noise
performance claim.\\
Observational performance & Independent references and repeatability establish
the named amplitude, shape, position, covariance, or false-rate metric. & No
production-readiness claim.\\
Production readiness & Operational profile, complete products, failure/log
audit, dependency closure, release controls, and owner approval all pass. & No
authority beyond the exact released profile and contract version.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

All nine stable MAP scope decisions are decided for this candidate.  A claim
may still be blocked by an unapproved source binding, an unavailable producer,
or missing conformance evidence; record that state without weakening the
requirement or substituting a fallback.

\section{Execution order and atomicity protocol}

Run evidence in the following order so later evidence cannot mask an earlier
contract failure:

\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Stage A---structural.} Parse and freeze exact identity and
parent, generation, source/profile binding, producer availability, and
required decision realization for frozen PTC r0.5, the exact PTC-to-MAP
boundary, and the AST same-\(n\) signal
coordinate, all boundaries/profiles, units, lifecycle, WCS, MAP policy, and
required-product plan.  When the uniform route is selected, require the exact
uniform Registry, family, and handoff identities declared in the shared
authority; selection alone supplies no coefficient and creates no default.
Reject direct CAL, PTC-disabled, missing-product,
inferred no-op, and cross-generation routes before payload retrieval.
\item \textbf{Stage B---safe numerical classification.} Retrieve only
structurally admitted transformed-signal and coefficient payloads. Classify
\(z_i\) as finite, non-finite, or unrepresentable and \(\gamma_i\) as finite
strictly positive, exact zero, negative finite, non-finite, or
unrepresentable. Verify coefficient availability itself imposed no finiteness
requirement. Separately validate the exact observation-resolved coverage cut
before application: zero, ordinary \((0,1]\), above one admitted only by an
independently authorized same-value/scope
\code{coverage_cut_above_one_override_requested} fact, or invalid when
missing, non-finite, negative, or unrepresentable. The number above one never
authorizes itself. Invalid input fails before support construction, application,
or mutation; no realized cut value is a pre-application prerequisite.
\item \textbf{Stage C---coordinate and product.} Evaluate exact AST coordinate
validity, one-hot placement/boundary, and only the companions required by the
exact selected observation/coadd product role.
For every VAL-evaluated gate retain request, applicability, eligibility, and
realization axes, source binding, immutable reason, cause, and failure scope.
Only requested/applicable/eligible/realized passes. Verify separately that the
PTC coefficient/QC pass uses its exact PTC-owned profile and neither replaces
nor rescues \SCIMapUpstreamProfile.
\item \textbf{Stages D and E---membership then accumulation.} Construct
membership only after Stages A--C and perform no payload arithmetic until all
required gates pass. Verify no numeric-zero mask, late masking, or aggregate
sanitization substitutes for admission. Then compare exact scientific
output-row identity and cardinality, plus
one-pixel, one-hot half-open-boundary, prohibited-fractional, covariance,
fixed-state response, full-procedure comparison-space typing, and distinct-fact
observation outputs, to independent expected values; retained storage rows do
not count as scientific output rows.
\item Exercise original-footprint exposure fixtures: one original influencing
several descendants at different pixels; original and descendants in
different pixels; missing original coordinate; boundary loss; multiple maps
sharing one original; distinct observations with numerically identical
original coordinates; and donor/synthesized descendants. Verify exact
observation/UID/native/stable-ALIGN-slot/generation keys, layered AST
ALIGN-grid parent in the target WCS, one own-coordinate placement, separate
influence edges, and no precision or temporal-support promotion.
\item Verify complete immutable observation-bundle construction as a logical
artifact. Independently request all three observation roles and record each
reached requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized plan
stage; a completed realization has all five, a pre-application stop has no
applied/realized records, and an applied terminal failure has no realized
product. Exercise
required publication for persisted routes plus explicitly selected in-memory
and coadd-only routes.  In-memory retention is not a waived product.
\item Snapshot coadd-owned state; test every compatibility failure under each
selected role; require atomic nonmutation. Confirm that base-permitted
unavailable or basis-incompatible response and incomplete covariance preserve
the base signal membership and publish exact status/cause.
\item Evaluate all four axes of the registered observation-coadd admission
aggregate profile separately from the MAP lifecycle; then independently
request all three coadd roles and exercise admitted
centered-integer coaddition, exact coadd output-row identity, and companion
placement.  If a canonical target grid was requested before observation-map
construction, verify that every constructed map honors it.  Otherwise verify
that already existing compatible bundles, including persisted coadd-only
inputs, may select a common coadd target and use exact centered-integer
embedding without modifying or relabeling their scientific samples.  An
explicit crop creates a new row-selected product with its own identity and
provenance.
\item Round-trip all required representations and reconstruct each
row-selected operator from provenance. Evaluate the physical FITS and typed
WCS on every preregistered scientifically addressable pixel center and every
outer-footprint cell vertex, including all corners, with the exact index
mapping, common WCS generation/frame, binary64 great-circle metric, and
fail-on-invalid rule. Infer no continuum maximum from that finite population.
\item Exercise fixed-state, PTC full-procedure, and PTC+MAP re-resolved
response families. For every numerical \(\Delta z\) or \(\Delta m\), require
the complete baseline/perturbed identities, quantity/unit, rows, frames/WCS,
reference/gauge/null state, supports, coefficient/response bases, exact common
domain and both maps, unmatched-row treatment, perturbation parameters,
finite-difference convention, state transition, availability, and cause.
Reject implicit fill, intersection, coordinate/shape/position association,
interpolation, reprojection, or gauge alignment; a state delta alone never
authorizes subtraction. Reconstruct and disclose the complete MAP-local operator
\(A_{{\mathrm{MAP}},\Pi}\), the immutable realized plan \(\Pi\), and row
selector \(J_{\rm out}\) with its exact output-row domain for every valid
product, while
marking the whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP role unavailable unless a
separate approved authority establishes it; exercise an already realized
PTC-grid companion applied exactly once; and honest response/covariance
disclosure. For a response-bearing role, require only every exact response
object named by that role; absence of a different unselected response family
does not block it. For coadd covariance, require
every block named by the selected covariance-qualified role before accepting the complete numerical propagation and
otherwise require partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or
unavailable state on the base role. Verify no stronger role subsets an existing
base parent and verify versioned binding for later derivative products.
\item Exercise consumer claim boundaries and immutable base/unfiltered MAP
parentage without assuming a closed-world registry of all future scientific
uses.  Verify that Pointing and OOF receive only permission to reuse the exact
ordinary MAP gridding operator when their inputs conform.  Their WCS/frame,
model/fitting, interpretation, outputs, defaults, profiles, and qualification
remain mode-owned, and no unsupplied mode profile is activated.
\item Repeat supported execution modes under the preregistered floating-point
policy, while requiring exact discrete facts.
\item Only after deterministic gates pass, execute representation, external,
observational, and operational evidence appropriate to the requested claim.
\end{enumerate}

For every failure-injection test, capture pre-state, attempted input, emitted
diagnostic, post-state, publication/cardinality state, and completion state.
No partial-state comparison may omit a coadd companion merely because its
payload was not the injected failure target.

\subsection{Scope-discrimination cases}

The following cases make the targeted r0.2 amendments discriminating. Each
case records every reached requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied,
and realized state and asserts role-qualified atomic nonmutation on rejection.

\SCIMapProductRoleDefinition

\SCIMapProductRoleDependencyTable

\begin{longtable}{L{0.27\linewidth}L{0.30\linewidth}L{0.33\linewidth}}
\toprule
Decision surface & Admitted case & Required discriminator\\
\midrule
Uniform coefficient authority & Exact Registry/family/handoff selection and a
PTC-complete same-generation payload. & Admit only through the frozen
PTC-to-MAP boundary; no default, fallback, or coefficient synthesis.\\
Coverage cut & Finite requests at 0, within \((0,1]\), and above 1. & Classify
zero and ordinary values separately from the independently authorized typed
above-one override; reject numerical self-authorization and missing, negative,
non-finite, or unrepresentable values before support/application/mutation.\\
Coverage stages & Values differ across reached lifecycle stages. & Validate
\(c_{\rm observation\_resolved}\) before application, then require exact
\(c_{\rm applied}=c_{\rm observation\_resolved}\) at the event. Evaluate the
inclusive predicates with \(c_{\rm applied}\); create no future-stage
placeholder and never require \(c_{\rm realized}\) to authorize application.\\
Coverage order statistic & \(N=0\) and preregistered small populations around
integer transitions. & Reproduce the exact zero-based
\(\lfloor(\lfloor0.75N\rfloor+N)/2\rfloor\) index and selected ordered value;
verify inclusive thresholds and finite-positive row requirement.\\
Bundle completeness & Required companions retained in memory, persisted, and
consumed by a coadd-only route. & The logical bundle and plan remain complete;
publication is required only for routes whose plan requires persistence.\\
Target grid & A preconstruction canonical grid is requested, or existing
bundles have otherwise-compatible shapes. & Honor the requested grid; otherwise
select a compatible common coadd target and use exact centered-integer
embedding.  Reject relabeling or resampling as a way to manufacture
compatibility.\\
Crop & Explicit row selection after construction. & Emit a new identified
product with selector/provenance; do not mutate or relabel the base grid.\\
Response & Valid fixed-state and procedure-response products. & Disclose exact
MAP-local \(A_{\mathrm{MAP}},\Pi\) separately from any upstream or whole-chain
claim; numerical procedure deltas require both exact maps into one authorized
comparison domain and all gauge/support/perturbation facts.\\
Product roles & Independently request base, response-bearing, and
covariance-qualified observation and coadd roles. & Preserve exact base parent
and ordered membership; base-permitted unavailable companions do not reject;
a selected required companion blocks only that stronger role and never forms a
subset of an existing parent.\\
WCS population & Typed and FITS WCS differ at an interior center, outer
boundary vertex, corner, and one invalid point in turn. & Evaluate the full
preregistered population with exact spherical metric/frame/generation/
precision; reject on any invalid member and infer no continuum maximum.\\
NOI vocabulary & Present \(Q\), formal precision, complete covariance, NOI
conditional marginal second moment, NOI standardized signal, and an attempted
significance label. & Preserve exact roles and claims; stronger physical-noise,
uncertainty, significance, probability, false-rate, completeness, purity, or
catalogue meaning remains unavailable without a separately approved method.\\
Pointing and OOF & Each requests exact ordinary MAP operator reuse. & Verify
only the shared operator boundary; require separate mode-owned WCS/frame,
model/fitting, interpretation, outputs, defaults, profile, and qualification,
and leave an unsupplied mode profile unavailable.\\
Application status & Contract sources compile without an identified producer
candidate. & Record contract completeness only; make no application
availability or conformance claim.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\section{Mechanical completeness checks}

Before a conformance verdict, automated checks shall establish:

\begin{itemize}
\item exactly one declaration of each stable requirement and prediction ID in
the shared authority, with no gaps or duplicates;
\item every requirement appears in this specification and in
\texttt{CROSSWALK.md}; every prediction is linked to at least one requirement;
\item each rendered PDF identifies contract v0.2 and its current document
revision separately;
\item no unresolved LaTeX reference, citation, overfull box, clipped glyph,
broken table, or unreadable page remains;
\item every required artifact reopens successfully, has the expected page
count, and renders every page through an independent PDF renderer; and
\item the owner-decision ledger and author-draft decision record contain no
silent resolution of an open scientific question.
\end{itemize}

The conformance verdict uses the same exact five-value requirement-result
vocabulary. It is \texttt{pass} only when every applicable requirement is
\texttt{pass} on the exact candidate. Any contradictory evaluated requirement
makes it \texttt{fail}; otherwise any missing named prerequisite makes it
\texttt{blocked}; otherwise any applicable unevaluated requirement makes it
\texttt{not\_assessed}. \texttt{not\_applicable} is permitted only for a
requirement outside the exact candidate's declared role with an owner-approved
rationale. Evidence-artifact \texttt{incomplete} is never a requirement result.
This document records every placeholder as \texttt{not\_assessed} and asserts
no verdict.

\section{Required handoff contents}

An engineering handoff contains the candidate and authority identities;
requirement result table using exactly \texttt{pass}/\texttt{fail}/
\texttt{blocked}/\texttt{not\_applicable}/\texttt{not\_assessed}; a separate
artifact-realization field using exactly \texttt{complete}/\texttt{incomplete}/
\texttt{failed}/\texttt{not\_produced}; prediction result table; exact commands and
environment; independent expected-value artifacts; build/test/log outputs;
representation and observational evidence where claimed; failure-injection
snapshots; skipped/blocked items; deviations and owner dispositions; and an
explicit statement for each claim layer. The handoff shall not collapse
``conforms algebraically,'' ``represents faithfully,'' ``performs on sky,'' and
``ready for production'' into one status word.
